# Rule 7 - Speak in English only
This is an English-speaking server. When communicating in-game, please only use English when speaking.
## Precedents - This rule extends to both LOOC (local out-of-character) and OOC (out-of-character) discussions and conversations. - Occasional words from other languages are fine as long as they serve a genuine roleplay purpose [bold]and[/bold] are cleared by an admin before their respective use(s).
